question: Did Mara open the lighthouse museum every Thursday?
story: Every Thursday, Mara opened the lighthouse museum before sunrise to polish its brass telescope. One foggy morning, she found a small blue envelope tucked beneath its stand. Inside was a sketch of a silver fox and a note asking her to leave a cup of tea on the western windowsill.
